captions.detailed: A 3D model of a drill-press vise rendered in dark and light gray shades. It features a flat rectangular base with an integrated fixed jaw on one end, parallel guide rails extending along the length of the base, and a central threaded leadscrew. A sliding jaw assembly sits on the rails and is driven by the leadscrew, moving back and forth along a prismatic joint to clamp objects against the fixed jaw.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a drill-press vise in CadQuery. It should feature a flat base with an integrated fixed jaw, parallel guide rails, a central leadscrew, and a sliding jaw that moves along the rails via a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a box primitive, then add the fixed jaw on one end using another box. Model parallel guide rails with chamfered or angled profiles, and place a central cylindrical leadscrew between them. Build the sliding jaw with a hollowed underside to clear the rails, and define a prismatic joint to allow translation of the sliding jaw relative to the base assembly along the longitudinal axis.
